title: Freedom in Christ
definition: Freedom in Christ is the believer's liberation from condemnation, slavery to sin, and bondage to man-made righteousness.
summary: Freedom in Christ is liberation from condemnation, slavery to sin, and bondage to man-made righteousness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the liberating Savior who makes His people truly free.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Freedom in Christ is the believer's release from condemnation, slavery to sin, and the burden of earning acceptance with God. Scripture presents freedom not as self-rule, but as belonging to Jesus.

This freedom does not mean the believer is free to live selfishly. Christ frees His people from the masters that destroy them so they can serve God with joy and love.

The Son makes sinners free by His death and resurrection. True freedom is found under His lordship, where grace removes condemnation and the Spirit leads believers into obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Freedom in Christ matters because people often confuse liberty with doing whatever they want. This doctrine corrects both legalism and lawlessness by showing that grace frees believers from bondage into faithful life with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Refuse to return to chains Christ has broken, whether guilt, religious performance, hidden sin, or people-pleasing. Use your freedom to love, serve, worship, and obey from a heart made alive by grace.
